about_the_game:
SOLSTORM is a classic style hand-crafted arcade bullet hell. Step in the shoes of a space-child that must embark on a bullet-ridden space odyssey to rescue his pets!

Experience the first stage and boss fight in this demo!

NOTE: Best experienced with a controller!

NOTE: Progress carries over to final release!

short_description: SOLSTORM is a classic hand-crafted bullet hell, simple enough for new players, and challenging enough for those who seek one. Skillfully weave, and dodge through waves of projectiles in the Stage 1 Demo!
